snippet.title: Fevercide - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3314140/Fevercide/

Fevercide is a metroidvania with elements of horror and adventure games. Join Sandra in the aesthetics of 1930s. Solve puzzles, fight with monsters, and face the demons from her past.

Fevericide is developed by Slava Gris, who combines his own art and code to bring  the game's weird and beautiful world to life. The soundtrack is composed by Shikami - https://music.apple.com/ru/artist/kyle-burchuk/1639950719
